title: ClearSigningSlashCmd
tagline: Draft an ERC-7730 metadata JSON by simply pasting any contract address
description: We define a custom Claude slash command, which enables the user to speedrun the creation of an ERC-7730 metadata JSON by simply pasting any contract address. The artefact created in Ledger's ERC-7730 clear signing registry only requires a final review from the user; at least 80% of the work is done already.
how_its_made:
Calling the custom /draft command, Claude autonomously walks through the following steps for the user:
- Python environment setup
- Retrieve the contract's ABI and source code via Etherscan
- Bootstrap a barebones metadata JSON file using the ` erc7730`  PyPI package
- Supplement the metadata JSON file with human readable labels and descriptions
- Verify the JSON's correctness both by linting and formatting it with the ` erc7730`  package
